question.text: The final versions of SID and SAI, after incorporating SEBI's observations, are made available on:

explanation.text: The Logic: After SEBI reviews the draft SID/SAI and provides observations, the AMC incorporates those observations and the final versions are made available on the AMFI (Association of Mutual Funds in India) website for public access. The Trap: The SEBI website hosts the DRAFT versions, not the final versions. This draft-on-SEBI, final-on-AMFI distinction is a classic exam trap. RBI and NSE have no role in hosting mutual fund scheme documents. Cross-Exam Context: NISM V-B and XII test this document hosting distinction. Remember: SEBI = drafts for review, AMFI = finals for investor access. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Bookmark the AMFI website (amfiindia.com) — it is your single most important resource for accessing the latest SID, SAI, and KIM of any scheme from any AMC. It also provides NAV data, performance data, and investor education resources.
